visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of Wonyoung from IVE shown on a massive LED screen inside a dark stadium. She wears a white, strapless, textured gown and a delicate necklace, holding a gold trophy and speaking into a microphone. The background consists of a bokeh-blurred crowd with purple and red stage lighting. (2) A sharp cut moves to the live stage where IU and Park Bo-gum stand side-by-side. IU is dressed in a strapless silver-grey sequined gown, while Park Bo-gum wears a crisp white tuxedo with a black bowtie. They are looking at each other, holding microphones, and performing under bright, white spotlights in a large venue. (3) The scene shifts to the audience area where IU is seated, smiling warmly and looking toward the stage. Next, Kim Yoo-jung is captured in a medium shot, wearing a black strapless dress; she laughs and shyly covers her face with her hands as a man beside her films the moment with his smartphone. (4) A series of rapid montages follow, showing groups like NewJeans and Kiss of Life standing on stage during their acceptance moments. They are holding flower bouquets and trophies, bowing deeply to the crowd. The lighting is high-contrast and vivid, with yellow variety-style text overlays appearing frequently at the bottom of the frame. (5) The final segment shows a male performer, Woodz, singing on a large outdoor screen at night. The camera pans out to show a massive stadium crowd holding glowing lightsticks, creating a sea of light. The stage structure is complex with multiple smaller screens displaying different angles of the performance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear female voice speaking Mandarin with a polite, soft, and slightly high-pitched intonation. A low-volume ambient music bed with soft piano chords plays in the background, accompanied by the distinct sound of a distant, cheering stadium crowd. (2) A sharp transition occurs as a male and female voice begin singing an acoustic pop duet. Their voices are melodic and clear, with moderate speech rate and high pitch variability. The crowd's cheering and applause increase significantly in intensity, occasionally competing with the singing. (3) The track shifts into a series of short vocal clips. Various female voices are heard greeting the audience in both Mandarin and Korean, characterized by high arousal and fast delivery. Distinct 'whoosh' sound effects mark the rapid transitions between these different speech segments. (4) The final phase features a male singer performing a live track with Mandarin lyrics. His voice is powerful and resonant, exhibiting high arousal and confidence. The background music swells into a high-tempo pop-rock arrangement with prominent drum beats and synthesizer textures, blending with the sound of thousands of fans.
